description: Fast, native file search engine and launcher: name search, content search, and a daemon behind both
post_install: info 'rgy: READ THIS. Despite the name, searchctl is NOT a systemd service and does not require systemd.'
info '  It is a plain CLI. The daemon (searchd) is a separate, OPTIONAL binary.'
info '  Scoop did not install or start it. Nothing here depends on the system init.'
info '  rgxy (the launcher) needs a RUNNING daemon; without one it says ''no connection to the daemon''.'
$choice = 'N'
if ([Environment]::UserInteractive) {
info ''
info '  How do you want the search daemon enabled?'
info '    [1] Register it for the NEXT LOGON only (the install does not start it now).'
info '    [2] Register it AND start it NOW in this session.'
info '    [N] Do nothing (default).'
info '  Note: registering alone never starts the daemon in the current session - HKCU Run'
info '  entries run at logon. And on its first start the daemon rebuilds the index of your'
info '  home directory before it opens its pipe, which can take a minute on a large tree;'
info '  rgxy will keep saying ''no connection to the daemon'' until that rebuild finishes.'
$choice = Read-Host 'Choose [1/2/N]'
} else {
info '  (non-interactive install: not asking. Run rgy-autostart install yourself to enable it.)'
if ($choice -match '^[12]') {
info '  Registering the daemon (no elevation, no dialog) ...'
& (Join-Path $dir 'rgy-autostart.exe') install
$daemon = Join-Path $dir 'searchd.exe'
$runKeyPs = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run'
$runKeyReg = 'HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run'
$installedCmd = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $runKeyPs -Name rgy-searchd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty rgy-searchd)
$listen = if ($installedCmd -match '--listen\s+(\S+)') { $Matches[1] } else { 'pipe:rgy-searchd-' + $env:USERNAME }
$runCmd = '"' + $daemon + '" --root ' + $env:USERPROFILE + ' --listen ' + $listen
reg add $runKeyReg /v rgy-searchd /t REG_SZ /d $runCmd /f | Out-Null
info '  Registered through ''current'', so the next version bump keeps the daemon working.'
if ($choice -match '^2') {
info '  Starting the daemon now (detached; it keeps running after this install) ...'
Start-Process -FilePath $daemon -ArgumentList '--root',$env:USERPROFILE,'--listen',$listen -WindowStyle Hidden
info '  It is indexing your home directory first; rgxy connects when the pipe opens.'
info '  Check progress with: rgy-autostart doctor'
} else {
info '  Registered. It will start at your NEXT LOGON, not now.'
info '  To start it sooner: rgy-autostart doctor, or Start-Process searchd.exe.'
info '  Undo it later with: rgy-autostart uninstall'
} else {
info '  No daemon installed. Two things to know:'
info '   - searchctl needs an INDEX, not a daemon. Index at least once:'
info '       searchctl --root $env:USERPROFILE --reindex --count ''*'''
info '   - Try rgxy with nothing installed: Start-Process searchd.exe -ArgumentList ''--root'',$env:USERPROFILE,''--listen'',''pipe:rgy-try''; rgxy.exe --endpoint pipe:rgy-try --query invoice'
info '     Or just use searchctl for one question. See the README for a daily index timer.'
